messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: runtime.service.cluster — elevated 5xx error rate detected (model-runner). Alert threshold: 15m error rate > 8%. Root metrics: 5xx surge, increased tail latency.

molly: I'm on it. pulling dashboards now. which pool is this hitting?

Tom: seeing a lot of segfaults from model-runner on gpunode-3. Logs show repeated 'CUDA_FREE(): double free' followed by OOM before crash.

Tom: paste logs: ```2026-03-15T12:01:02Z model-runner[pid=4219]: E libc++abi: terminating with uncaught exception of type std::bad_alloc
2026-03-15T12:01:03Z model-runner[pid=4219]: F segfault at 0 ip 00007f8c... gs 0 era 0
2026-03-15T12:01:03Z model-runner: GPU memory usage 31.9 GiB / 32.0 GiB
```

raj: copy. looks like a GPU OOM or driver-level fault causing segfaults. gpunode-3 has been restarted twice in last 10m by kube. Are other pods on the same host?

Tom: Yes, two heavy batches pinned to that node — batch executor + model-runner. We saw a surge in request concurrency from a few heavy customers.

jamie: support telemetry: customer-visible errors rising. Affected endpoints: /v1/chat and /v1/generate for models redwood-gpt-large. Top 10 tenants: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c show timeouts and 502s. ETA on mitigation? Customers flagging in Slack.

molly: immediate plan: 1) remove gpunode-3 from service (cordon/drain), 2) route new traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-gpt-large-quant) in region, 3) scale up pool by +2 nodes if autoscaler slow, 4) enable degraded-mode timeouts so requests don't pile up.

raj: executing now. `kubectl cordon gpunode-3` && `kubectl drain gpunode-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

deploy-bot: rollout: traffic-router -> enable fallback routing to redwood-gpt-large-quant (canary 100%) — started by molly.

Tom: pushing a quick runtime flag to disable aggressive batch resizing on the node group (hotpatch): ```--max-batch-tokens=2048 -> 1024``` will reduce memory spikes. Deploying to pool config.

molly: raj, can you confirm draining completes? we need to ensure model instances don't restart onto the same node.

raj: drain completed. pods rescheduled to gpunode-7 and gpunode-9. gpunode-7 has capacity. I've tainted gpunode-3 with NoSchedule for now.

jamie: customer impact update: error-rate peaked at +22% for last 5m, now down to +7% since fallback routing. We have 18 open support tickets referencing 502/timeouts; 3 enterprise tenants are actively reporting production incidents.

emily: posting to status page: "Partial degradation for model redwood-gpt-large in us-west-2; mitigation in progress, some requests may see higher latency or 502s. Engineers are investigating."

Tom: quick analysis: reproducer looks like memory fragmentation + large KV cache growth under a particular prompt pattern (long system prompts + streaming). Root cause candidate: combination of aggressive batching + unbounded KV cache growth leading to driver allocation failure.

molly: plan for next hour: 1) maintain fallback routing, 2) monitor error-rate and p95 latency, 3) keep gpunode-3 isolated, 4) roll forward hotpatch to reduce batch size, 5) open postmortem ticket and assign owners.

raj: also enabling temporary autoscaler override: +2 nodes in us-west-2 gpu-pool to buy time. watching GPU utilization.

jamie: notifying top customers via standard incident template and offering priority support calls.

Tom: note — we should not enable swapfile on GPU nodes; that won't help GPU allocations. Avoid that.

molly: agreed. action items: Tom -> root-cause debug and reproducer (owner). Raj -> ensure cluster stabilization and autoscale (+2) (owner). Jamie -> customer comms and ticket triage (owner). Emily -> status updates + page. I'll draft postmortem skeleton.

deploy-bot: canary routing completed. fallback model at 100% traffic.

raj: gpunode-3 shows driver crash loop detected. I've escalated host to infra for hardware checks. flagging potential imminent hardware replacement.

jamie: support: a couple tenants requested request-level logs for correlation IDs -> I'm pulling traces and will attach.

molly: handing off to night on-call: raj will take lead for ongoing monitoring. I'm going offline in 15m but will be reachable. raj please escalate if error-rate climbs >10% or any enterprise tenant reports degraded SLA.

raj: I'm taking lead. setting watch: error-rate alert at 10% -> pager. will update thread every 15m.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff recorded. next oncall: raj.

molly: thanks team. postmortem ticket created: IN-2999. assigned owners per above.

raj: current status: error-rate stabilized ~5-7%, p95 latency elevated by ~200ms for fallbacks. continuing monitoring. will coordinate with infra for gpunode-3 hardware postmortem and tom for memory leak investigation.

jamie: leaving a note for support rotation. customers informed.

emily: will follow up on mitigation timeline and include rollback/patch path in postmortem.

Tom: saving heap snapshots and KV cache profiles to s3://redwood-debug/in-2999/ for RCA.

molly: closing active pager but keeping incident channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
